tasks.title: Dart BackingMixer + golden fixture
tasks.prompt: Match surrounding style. Change only the allowed files. No new dependencies. Backing mixer contract (identical in Dart and Kotlin). Class BackingMixer(sampleRate). load(stems: Int16 arrays, one mono stem per instrument group, each covering the whole song; renderBpm; ticksPerBar; intervalMicros). A song bar b starts at stem sample barStartFrame(bar: b, epochFrame 0). mix(out, chunkStart, engineBpm, epochFrame, ticksPerBar, intervalMicros) ADDS stem*gain/32768 into out for absolute frames [chunkStart, chunkStart+out.length). Audible only while |renderBpm-engineBpm|<0.001 and intervalMicros equal; else silence. command(token, kind launch|stop, fromBar, bars, loop, atBar): transport bar t starts at barStartFrame(t, epochFrame). A command takes effect at the start of transport bar atBar (queued before that: emit state queued). For t>=atBar the song bar is fromBar+((t-atBar) mod bars) if loop, fromBar+(t-atBar) while < fromBar+bars otherwise (then stopped). Within transport bar t, frame f maps to stem sample songBarStart(songBar)+(f-barStart(t)), zero-padded or truncated at the song bar's length (re-anchor every bar: drift can never exceed one frame). A stop command with atBar stops at that bar start. setGain(stem, gain) ramps linearly over 5 ms. A change of epochFrame or engine intervalMicros between mix calls stops playback and emits state stopped(reason epoch). State callback: onState(token, state queued|playing|stopped, transportBar). Implement it in Dart: lib/services/audio/engine/backing_mixer.dart (use lib/utils/bar_math.dart; out is Float32List). Create test/fixtures/backing_golden.json (under 200 KB) with parametric cases (rate 48000, intervalMicros 487805, ticksPerBar 4, renderBpm 123; impulse stems = 1.0 sample at every beat start of the song bars, expressed as rules not raw arrays) and expected non-zero output frames; cases: launch queued at transport bar 3 starts exactly at barStartFrame(3); loop 2 bars; non-loop ends and emits stopped; stop at bar; tempo mismatch is silent; gain 0 mutes; epoch change stops; 5 minutes of bars aligned within 1 frame of the click grid.
